import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Query mean NO2 for all stations in June 2025
query = text("""
SELECT station_id, AVG(no2) as mean_no2
FROM hourly_station_air_quality
WHERE datetime >= '2025-06-01 00:00:00' 
AND datetime < '2025-07-01 00:00:00'
AND no2 IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY station_id
ORDER BY mean_no2 DESC
""")
df = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print(df.head(10))

import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Get station 14 name and coordinates
query = text("""
SELECT id, name_en, ST_X(coordinate::geometry) as lng, ST_Y(coordinate::geometry) as lat
FROM air_quality_station
WHERE id = 14
""")
station_info = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print(station_info)

# Find dominant land_category within 500m buffer
query = text("""
SELECT luc.land_category, SUM(ST_Area(ST_Intersection(
    ST_Buffer(
        (SELECT coordinate FROM air_quality_station WHERE id = 14)::geography,
        500
    )::geometry,
    luc.geometry
))) as intersection_area
FROM land_use_zone luc
WHERE ST_Intersects(
    ST_Buffer(
        (SELECT coordinate FROM air_quality_station WHERE id = 14)::geography,
        500
    )::geometry,
    luc.geometry
)
GROUP BY luc.land_category
ORDER BY intersection_area DESC
LIMIT 1
""")
landuse = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print(landuse)

# Count HEALTH_CARE_INSTITUTION sensitive areas within 1000m (centroid check)
query = text("""
SELECT COUNT(*) as health_count
FROM sensitive_area sa
WHERE sa.category = 'HEALTH_CARE_INSTITUTION'
AND ST_DWithin(
    (SELECT coordinate FROM air_quality_station WHERE id = 14)::geography,
    ST_Centroid(sa.geometry)::geography,
    1000
)
""")
health = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print(health)

import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Verify land use categories within 500m and their areas
query = text("""
SELECT luc.land_category, 
       ST_Area(luc.geometry) as zone_area,
       ST_Area(ST_Intersection(
           ST_Buffer(
               (SELECT coordinate FROM air_quality_station WHERE id = 14)::geography,
               500
           )::geometry,
           luc.geometry
       )) as intersection_area
FROM land_use_zone luc
WHERE ST_Intersects(
    ST_Buffer(
        (SELECT coordinate FROM air_quality_station WHERE id = 14)::geography,
        500
    )::geometry,
    luc.geometry
)
ORDER BY intersection_area DESC
LIMIT 10
""")
landuse_detail = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print(landuse_detail)
